en_title: Barbie 2 May Not Happen as Warner Bros. and Creative Team Clash Over Pay Demands
cn_title: 《芭比》续集或难产，华纳与主创谈薪
subtitle: 续集悬了
opus_summary: 华纳兄弟与《芭比》主创团队因片酬谈判陷入僵局，续集若年底前未进入开发，版权将回归美泰。高斯林要求2000万美元(约合人民币1亿元)预付片酬。

paragraphs.en: There's a race to get Barbie 2 made, but a financial feud between Warner Bros. and the film's creative team (including Margot Robbie and Ryan Gosling) could kill the project.
paragraphs.cn: 各方正争分夺秒推动《芭比》续集落地，但华纳兄弟与影片主创团队（包括玛格特·罗比和瑞恩·高斯林）之间的薪酬纠纷，可能让这个项目夭折。

paragraphs.en: According to a new report from Variety , Warner Bros. has until the end of the year to get a Barbie sequel into development ; otherwise, it'll lose the opportunity for good. The reason for this is that the rights for a film will revert back to Barbie owner Mattel if WB can't get contracts signed for the team behind the project. However, there's one big issue: They're all struggling to agree on terms.
paragraphs.cn: 据《综艺》最新报道，华纳兄弟必须在今年年底前推动《芭比》续集进入开发阶段，否则将永久失去这次机会。原因在于，如果华纳无法与项目主创团队签订合同，影片版权就会回归《芭比》版权持有者美泰。不过，眼下存在一个重大问题：各方始终难以就相关条款达成一致。

paragraphs.en: Warner Bros. didn't option a sequel when developing the first film, partially because it didn't expect the movie to end up grossing nearly $1.5 billion or score a bunch of nominations at the Oscars . As a result, the studio is paying for its lack of foresight. Since there was nothing agreed upon, director Greta Gerwig, writing partner Noah Baumbach, and stars Margot Robbie and Ryan Gosling have a lot of room to negotiate. Warner Bros. has reportedly made six offers for a sequel over the last three years, with the most recent reportedly being the highest in the studio's history, though the team is holding its ground and asking for more.
paragraphs.cn: 华纳兄弟在开发首部电影时没有取得续集的选择权，部分原因是没想到这部电影最终能获得近15亿美元(约合人民币101亿元)票房，或是在奥斯卡颁奖典礼上拿到大量提名。如今，这家制片厂正为当初缺乏远见付出代价。由于此前没有敲定任何条件，导演格蕾塔·葛韦格、编剧搭档诺亚·鲍姆巴赫，以及主演玛格特·罗比和瑞恩·高斯林都有很大的谈判空间。据报道，过去三年里华纳兄弟已经为续集提出六份报价，最近一份据称更是该制片厂历史上最高的报价。不过，主创团队仍坚持立场，要求更优厚的条件。

paragraphs.en: Variety's sources state that Gosling is asking for a whopping $20 million upfront to return as Ken, and the team is looking for generous deals on the backend, likely hoping for another big box office hit from which they can reap the rewards. Although Warner Bros. executives reportedly value this group, some are pointing the finger at CEO David Zaslav for the holdup. If Zaslav doesn't budge, Barbie 2 will die.
paragraphs.cn: 《综艺》的消息人士称，高斯林要求获得2000万美元(约合人民币1亿元)的预付片酬，以回归饰演肯；主创团队还在寻求优厚的后端分成条件，似乎希望续集再次取得票房成功，并从中获得回报。尽管据报道华纳兄弟高管很看重这支团队，但一些人将谈判停滞归咎于CEO大卫·扎斯拉夫。如果扎斯拉夫不肯让步，《芭比》续集就会告吹。

paragraphs.en: For some, that might be a good thing. Not every movie needs a sequel, and the first film didn't exactly set up a trilogy. Gerwig herself wasn't too interested in a Barbie sequel at first, but has come around on it , and now reportedly has an idea, but isn't spilling the beans on what that might look like until contracts are signed. In the meantime, the director is helming an adaptation of The Chronicles of Narnia , which will release early next year.
paragraphs.cn: 对一些人来说，这或许是好事。不是每部电影都需要续集，而且首部电影也没有明确为三部曲铺路。格蕾塔·葛韦格本人起初对《芭比》续集并不太感兴趣，但后来改变了态度。据报道，她如今已经有了一个构想，不过在合同签署前不会透露具体内容。与此同时，这位导演正在执导《纳尼亚传奇》改编电影，该片将于明年年初上映。
